The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Directorate of Education Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Directorate of Education Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Lecturer (Curriculum/ Material Development & Evaluation) and 1 for Lecturer (District Resource Unit For Adult Education/ Non-Formal Education (DRU For AE/ NFE)).

rows.post_name: Lecturer (District Resource Unit For Adult Education/ Non-Formal Education (DRU For AE/ NFE))

content_sections.heading: Directorate of Education Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Lecturer (Curriculum/ Material Development & Evaluation): Master's degree in Humanities/ Social Sciences/ Sciences with M.Ed. specialization in Curriculum and/ or Evaluation OR Master's in Child Psychology/ Child Development/ Education with Degree/ Diploma/ Certificate in Teacher Education OR Ph.D. in relevant field. 3 years teaching experience in school/ TEI. Knowledge of English/ Gujarati/ Marathi/ Hindi and computer literacy. Lecturer (District Resource Unit For Adult Education/ Non-Formal Education (DRU For AE/ NFE)): Master's degree in Humanities/ Social Sciences/ Sciences with PG/ Degree/ Diploma in Adult Education/ NFE or Social Work/ MSW or Community Development or Rural Development or Women's Studies or Communication or Journalism OR Degree in Teacher Education with specialization in AE/ NFE. 3 years experience in extension/ management of AE/ NFE programmes. Knowledge of English/ Gujarati/ Marathi/ Hindi and computer literacy.

content_sections.heading: Directorate of Education Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Rs. 45,000/ - per month for all posts.

Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https:/ / ddd.gov.in/ . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Directorate of Education Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Lecturer posts is 21st September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by the Directorate of Education?
faq.answer: The Directorate of Education has released a total of 2 vacancies for the post of Lecturer. These vacancies are for specific specializations as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Lecturer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Lecturer post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary for each Lecturer post. Generally, a Master's degree in relevant fields like Humanities, Social Sciences, Sciences, Education, or specialized degrees like M.Ed. or Ph.D. are required, along with teaching or relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Directorate of Education recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Lecturer positions?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves an application screening, followed by document verification and an interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these Lecturer positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these Lecturer positions is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Which city and state are these vacancies located in?
faq.answer: The vacancies are located in Daman, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Directorate of Education, which is https://ddd.gov.in/.
